Class TrainingRunner

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.cli.training.TrainingRunner
public class TrainingRunner extends Object
Runs a single <meta-optimizer>-tunes-<base-level-algorithm> meta-optimization training job described by a TrainingRequest, reusing the same builder/observer/output pipeline as the org.uma.evolver.example.training reference examples — one pipeline per meta-level encoding (see FlatMetaSearchConfig, TreeMetaSearchConfig).

Study prototype for uniformizing Evolver's training runners: this class replaces hardcoded Java constants and an ad hoc main(String[] args) with a single structured input (TrainingRequest) and a polled YAML status file, so it can be driven by an external process (e.g. a GUI) without recompiling. It runs headless by default — a live FrontPlotObserver is registered only when TrainingRequest.frontPlotFrequency() is present, since an external process driving this runner would not want a Swing window popping up on its machine.
